translated: Next, we have some listener mail from Radio name: Yusuke Ena-oshi.
Thank you very much.
We appreciate your support.
"Honnizumi-san, Suzuki-san, kon-niigo!"
Kon-niigo!
"This is the first time I've ever sent in listener mail."
That's wonderful.
Everyone's so sophisticated.
"What I look forward to in autumn is going for walks while feeling the cool breeze."
Oh, that's the best.
The absolute best.
It seems like everyone...
It's nice.
So mature.
"I don't handle the heat well, so I don't feel like going outside in the summer unless I have to,
but once autumn comes and it gets cooler, I go for walks quite often.
Seeing the autumn leaves and the sunset during those walks is very healing for me.
Last year, the cool period was so short that I didn't walk much, so I hope I can go for plenty of walks this year."
Minori loves going for walks too.
I try to do it normally, but yeah, summer is tough.
Rina isn't good with the heat either.
Yeah.
You can get heatstroke even if you're careful.
That's true.
I hope it keeps getting cooler so we have more to look forward to.
That sounds lovely.
The days getting shorter has its own emotional vibe, doesn't it?
It really does.
I wonder if it's starting to change already.
Once September hits, it usually changes quite a bit.
